_comment: Recorded holder data, NOT a live read. Balances were taken from the Etherscan token-holder list for the tracked contract on 2026-10-28, before the poller existed. Used by `npm run addresses:confirm -- --offline` to exercise and demonstrate the report without a network. Percentages were cross-checked against the 42.591 total supply and agree. The deployer's residual 0.151 is DERIVED by subtraction (totalSupply 42.591 - recorded holders 42.44) so the fixture balances internally; it was absent from the pasted holder list and needs confirming against Etherscan. Reconstructed Transfer history stands in for a log scan and is itself a reconstruction, not an observed log set.
